status: selection contract only; no managed API implementation or runtime qualification claimed
gate: No selected-pending operation is advertised until its runtime, ownership, error-path and raw/optimized JIT/NativeAOT gates pass.

error_policy.unsupported: Recognized excluded/deferred operations or option values: QUIC_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED / owning-facade NotSupportedException before dispatch or mutation.
error_policy.invalid: Unknown identifiers, reserved bits, wrong scope, invalid sizes and getter/setter direction: QUIC_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; preserve stricter upstream INVALID_STATE/BUFFER_TOO_SMALL on selected paths.
error_policy.void_api: Excluded void slots are not exposed by the facade. Do not invent a C status return or success no-op; retain raw ABI shape internally without claiming raw API parity.
error_policy.atomic_profile_validation: Check the entire requested payload before forwarding, including global/configuration/connection QUIC_SETTINGS and credential flags.
error_policy.future_identifiers: Default deny; inventory/profile update and tests required before exposure.

settings_policy.disabled_behavior: Effective initial value false; explicitly setting false is allowed, true returns NOT_SUPPORTED. Apply at every settings entry point before upstream changes state.
settings_policy.reserved_behavior: Reject every unknown/reserved IsSet bit and nonzero reserved flag. Preserve upstream numeric range, size/version and state validation on all allowed fields.
settings_policy.version_policy: Explicitly initialize all effective acceptable/offered/fully-deployed lists to v1; refuse other versions. Compiling v2 does not qualify or enable it.
settings_policy.transport_policy: Selected NAT rebinding, migration/path validation, CUBIC, pacing, flow control, loss recovery, retry, stateless reset, key/CID updates and datagrams remain core-owned.

credential_policy.first_facade_input: Owned certificate/private-key and trust objects or explicitly parsed bytes mapped by the picotls adapter; native QUIC_CREDENTIAL_CONFIG is not an unrestricted facade escape hatch.
excluded: Schannel certificate hash/store/context and credential attributes
credential_policy.flags: Only selected_pending_flags may be mapped by the owning adapter after tests. They are not a direct public raw flag bypass: deferred validation must retain actual trust/name checks; allowed ciphers remain the two selected AES-GCM suites. Every other credential flag is rejected with NOT_SUPPORTED before mutation.
credential_policy.provider_query: GLOBAL_TLS_PROVIDER returns the explicit managed-host extension MSQUIC_HOST_TLS_PROVIDER_PICOTLS = (QUIC_TLS_PROVIDER)0x10000; source enum remains unchanged. Root host contract records and tests this identity; no native provider impersonation.

capabilities.query_policy: Owning facade publishes a versioned qualification manifest only after tests; compiled API fields are not capabilities. DATAGRAM_SEND_ENABLED and actual connection/handshake queries report negotiated runtime state. CxPlatDataPathGetSupportedFeatures must not advertise absent host features; rejected options return NOT_SUPPORTED.
capabilities.required_gap_policy: Missing IPv6/source selection/binding/packet ownership or other selected behavior blocks profile completion; never silently remove it from the profile.

stream_shutdown.constraint: Preserve upstream valid combinations and callback-only INLINE/reentrancy semantics; NONE is not a promise that every call context permits an empty mask.

send.constraint: Preserve upstream stream/datagram-specific flag checks; a selected flag is not valid on every operation.

receive.constraint: Receive flags are observations; 0_RTT must never be delivered by a qualified first-profile connection.

resumption.constraint: Tickets support subsequent fresh 1-RTT data only; no early-data flags.

api_flags.unknown_bits: Reject before dispatch; numeric masks and valid combinations retain pinned upstream definitions.
